clips.title: The story
paras: Eva Sarkhoff is the spectral remnant of the former head maid of House Barov, lingering alongside her husband Lucien just outside the horrors of Scholomance. Tortured and slain by the Butcher during the fall of Caer Darrow, her spirit seeks brave mortals to avenge their deaths and destroy their cursed remains.

Eva served the wealthy Barov family for decades as their head maid, caring for the sprawling keep of Caer Darrow alongside her husband Lucien, the family butler. As the Barovs grew paranoid about their aging mortality and vast wealth, they struck a catastrophic pact with Kel'Thuzad. The manor was gradually handed over to the fledgling Cult of the Damned, warping the grand residence into Scholomance, a secretive academy of necromancy. Eva and Lucien hid in the keep's corridors for six months, scavenging food while watching cultists and monstrosities steadily take over their home.
